status: NONVERDICT exploration plus one methodological correction; no theorem, no counterexample
finding: Exact (rational z3 LP) adversarial minimisation of the omega-normalised five-node dual margin over band-root eligible boxes, pattern (2,1,3,2,4), using ONE extreme corner per node, drove the margin to 8.04e-7 (still positive). The minimisers approach three simultaneous contacts (E1|O1, O1|E2, O2|E3 relative gaps 9e-4, 7e-3, 6e-4); closing those gaps exactly keeps the margin positive (4.80e-7). The tight dual numerator is degenerate (only b1..b4 nonzero) and the near-certificate weight vector puts zero weight on node 4, i.e. it degenerates toward a four-node configuration, which the written m>=5 theorem forbids. Correction: a single extreme corner per node is NOT a complete five-node test. At a fixed node the admissible contributions form the 2-D cone spanned by the TWO extreme-angle corners of the Kharitonov rectangle; a merged member may be any interior direction, i.e. up to two corner atoms per node (up to 10 rows). The earlier conjecture-evidence sampling (frontier-20261029-five-node-box-pattern-sampling-kernel-v1.py) and this search inherit this incompleteness, so their 'zero certificates' counts are weaker evidence than stated.

evidence.note: exact box, nodes, corner choices and margin of the hardest single-corner configuration; floats in beta/mu are diagnostic only

blocker: No proof route yet for the five-node conjecture; the single-corner evidence does not cover two-atom nodes.
next_action: Replace the test by the complete per-node dual: b>=0 must pair nonnegatively with all four Kharitonov corners at every node (20 rows). Re-run adversarial minimisation with this complete test from the hardest configurations. A negative complete margin on an exactly eligible box would be a genuine strict certificate and hence an exact negative answer; a robustly positive pattern would guide a written proof.
scope: Exploratory exact LP arithmetic in one Python Eval kernel (z3 rationals); float hill-climb proposals carry no verdict. Not parent-adopted, formal, cross-vendor or novelty-cleared.
